children: Moleculin announced new Annamycin data to be presented at AACR and two European scientific meetings in September 2026.
Three presentations in Sept 2026 will examine Annamycin’s tissue concentration, mechanism (topoisomerase II targeting), and immune involvement.
AACR presentation (Sept 25–28) reports that Annamycin’s antitumor activity is partially mediated by CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity; abstract embargoed until publication.
Two presentations in Wroclaw, Poland (Sept 9–14) focus on organotropism and how tissue distribution relates to antitumor activity and mechanism.
Company says these data inform development of Annamycin for hard-to-treat cancers while MIRACLE AML trial remains the primary near-term focus.
